items.body_excerpt: Keaton Wagler’s FTr is up to .696 this season. It’d be the highest by any rookie 6’6” or shorter (min. 250 minutes) since Jimmy Butler posted a .709 mark in 2011-12, and the second-highest this century.

items.title: The Atlanta Hawks and Rafael Castro have agreed to a two-way deal, agents Kevin Bradbury and CJ Ward of LIFT Sports Management told HoopsHype. Castro was a 2-time All-Atlantic 10 Team selection and 2-time All-Atlantic 10 Defensive Team selection at George Washington University.

items.title: Phoenix tried to go small, pausing Ighodaro/Maluach lineups for a bit
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Phoenix tried to go small, pausing Ighodaro/Maluach lineups for a bit

Didn't matter -- back-to-back Lakers buckets force a Phoenix timeout with 3:36 left in 1st half

Lakers lead 58-39. They're outscoring Suns by 21 points with Jalen Green and Miles Bridges on the floor.

items.title: They gave Collin Sexton protective glasses to wear today.
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
They gave Collin Sexton protective glasses to wear today.

He told me pregame that it was an adjustment.

It is not surprising to me that he has tossed them lol

anyway... Sexton has 7 points (3/3 FGs) off bench and Lakers are up 47-33

Timeout Phoenix with 7:35 left in 1st half
